_id.description: MongoDB document identifier. Accepts ObjectId (driver default) or string (for deterministic ids derived from slug, e.g., UUIDv5).

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the category was created. Stored as MongoDB BSON date (millisecond precision).

depth.description: Tree depth from the root. 0 for root categories (parent_id=null). Capped at 16 to bound traversal cost; deeper trees are pathological for storefront UX.

description.description: Optional long-form category description for SEO / landing pages.

display_order.description: Sort order within the same parent. Lower values appear first.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata bag for category-specific attributes (banner_image_url, theme_color, featured_brands, etc.). Application-level Pydantic models constrain this further.

name.description: Human-readable category name (e.g., 'Apparel', 'Mobile Phones'). Multi-language support is provided via metadata.localized_names; this field is the canonical English name.

parent_id.description: Parent category id. NULL for root categories. Foreign-key-ish reference to a peer document in the same `categories` collection (NOT cross-service per AAP R-6).

path.description: Materialized path: array of slugs from root to this category, INCLUDING this category's own slug as the last element. For a root category, path = [own_slug]. For a depth-1 child, path = [root_slug, own_slug]. Enables fast ancestor queries via the `idx_categories__path` multikey index. maxItems=17 = depth max (16) + 1 to include the leaf itself.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (lowercase alphanumeric with single-hyphen separators). UNIQUE across all categories — enforced by the `idx_categories__slug` index. The pattern rejects empty segments, leading/trailing hyphens, and uppercase characters.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'draft' = not yet visible to storefront; 'active' = visible and selectable; 'archived' = soft-deleted (kept for historical product references but hidden from category listings).

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent update. Stored as MongoDB BSON date.
